title: Android's verification wall goes global in January, and sideloading gets a 24-hour wait
summary: Google will extend Android developer verification to all regions from January 2027 with seven app distributors: Google Play, Galaxy Store, Honor, Oppo, Xiaomi, Transsion and Vivo. Once live, apps from unregistered developers cannot be installed normally; power users must enable an advanced flow, authenticate, restart, wait 24 hours and then choose a seven-day or indefinite window. Verification requires government identification and a $25 fee. The rules already apply in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand. Google says registered apps cover over 99% of installs.
